title: French-Style Rice Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful side dish made with rice and a touch of Turkish spice. This recipe is perfect for accompanying your favorite French meals.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the rice and Turkish spice blend. Stir to combine and coat the rice with the spice.
Pour in the nourishing broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
